essence: This mantra is to be placed on the head.
One should recite the armor mantra as the supreme, auspicious, all-encompassing formula.
The weapon mantra should be placed immediately at the end of the armor.
After saying 'all-weapon', one commands the holding of all minds.
The eye mantra ends with 'maṃ phaṭ' after 'mahānanta'.
